Book Now Book Now Overview The Mystery Trail Camp is situated near Gopinatham, a quaint little hamlet on the border between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu. Situated in the Cauvery Wildlife Sanctuary, the camp offers amazing vistas and opportunities to enjoy Nature at its best. Look in any direction and one can see a chain of hills. A waterbody adjoin the camp adds to the beauty of the place. During the monsoon these dry forests turn into a verdant green that is soothing to the eyes. Gopinatham Mystery Trail Camp is located near Gopinatham village. The camp is located at a distance of about 250 km from Bangalore. Experience While you stay at the camp, explore the forest on foot. Visit the memorial of a celebrate forest officer who sacrificed his life while on the call of duty. Trek up to a vantage point to enjoy the uninterrupted vistas of the landscape. Visit the famed Hogenakkal falls – the Niagra of India some 13 km. from the camp. The raw power of the water experienced while in a coracle promises to be with you for a long time. Nature Walk Step into the nature with our naturalists. Our guided nature walks offer a close-up look at the ecosystem, covering native flora, birdlife, insects, and animal tracks. Designed for all ages, this immersive walk explores the woods beyond the traditional safari. Night Trail Discover nature after dark. Guided safely by our trained naturalists within our campus, the night trail reveals nocturnal biodiversity including insects, spiders, amphibians, and nocturnal birds. It is a thrilling experience that showcases the wild when the rest of the world is asleep. Season The best period to visit the Mystery Trail Camp is during the monsoon while Hogenakkal falls is best enjoyed post monsoon.
